documented_probe: C-f254b292 (implement an attention-gated pooling module in pytorch with fixed attribute names): reference floor is medium and this covering task exercises it at medium — three named gate/aggregate layers, softmax-normalized attention over the bag axis, and empty/single-element set edge cases checked on hidden configurations.
notes: The module is unit-checked by the verifier: exact attribute names (proj/score/head), attention weight shapes for rank-2 and rank-3 inputs, softmax sums to 1, bag=1 exact 1.0 weight, bag=0 no-crash, plus exact numeric equality (1e-4) against an in-container reference built under the same fixed seed. A CLI artifact on the visible cluster catalog is also required.
